description: Parse, validate and normalize URLs. Operations: "parse" — Break a URL into its component parts.; "validate" — Validate a URL and run basic security/heuristic checks.; "normalize" — Normalize a URL (drop default ports, sort query params, strip trailing slash).. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: parse: The URL to parse. validate: The URL to validate. normalize: The URL to normalize.

operation.description: parse — Break a URL into its component parts. validate — Validate a URL and run basic security/heuristic checks. normalize — Normalize a URL (drop default ports, sort query params, strip trailing slash).

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

name: url
title: URL Encoder & Decoder
